# uma.moe

> Mobile-first Umamusume database, Veteran workspace, race analysis, timeline, community data, and planning tools for the global version.

## Site navigation

### Main

- [Home](https://uma.moe/): Umamusume resource hub for the global version.
- [Database](https://uma.moe/database): Find optimal inheritance pairings and support cards for Uma Musume.
- [Tierlist](https://uma.moe/tierlist): Support card tierlist.
- [Timeline](https://uma.moe/timeline): Global content releases, pickups, and events.

### Community

- [Clubs](https://uma.moe/circles): Club database and fan progression.
- [Rankings](https://uma.moe/rankings): Global trainer fan rankings.
- [Activity](https://uma.moe/activity): Top 100 club activity reports.

### Competitive

- [Competitive](https://uma.moe/competitive): Race analysis and competitive racing data.
- [Race Analysis](https://uma.moe/competitive/race-analysis): Upload one or multiple races for replay and analysis.
- [CM Data](https://uma.moe/competitive/cm-data): Champions Meeting captured races and simulation data.

### Tools

- [Tools](https://uma.moe/tools): Advanced tools and statistics.
- [Statistics](https://uma.moe/tools/statistics): Team Stadium statistics.
- [Lineage Planner](https://uma.moe/tools/lineage-planner): Optimize inheritance trees and parent pairings.
- [Master Data](https://uma.moe/tools/master-data): Browse game tables and run SQLite queries locally.

### Research

- [Research](https://uma.moe/research): Hakuraku research notes on racing and game mechanics.

### System

- [Privacy](https://uma.moe/privacy-policy): Privacy policy.

## Machine-readable navigation

- [Feature metadata](https://uma.moe/meta/features.json)
- [Route navigation graph](https://uma.moe/meta/navigation.json)
- [Schema.org navigation](https://uma.moe/meta/navigation.jsonld)

## Data and privacy

Public metadata never contains private account, Veteran, race, or standalone-client payloads. Authentication is required before account-owned data is requested.
